text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, move it!
I was just about to use that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you talking about?
Would you stop making false accusations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I walked into the gym and found two Umamusume
arguing. There was only one open Smith machine,
as the others had "Out of Order" signs on them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho~w...! Looks like quite the dispute going on over there.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, you two!
Are you squabbling over that machine there?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—I was gonna use it first, but then this girl—!
—I had my eye on it first!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. The two of you arguing amongst yourselves
isn't going to get us anywhere.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: How about this, then! I shall hear both of your reasons and pass judgment on who gets to use it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It would be fair if a third party examined the reasons
and made the judgment, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I've got a race coming up that I can't afford to lose.
My start dash is lacking, so I want to build up explosive power with barbell squats.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely have to win my next race too!
What I need is acceleration through arm pumping...
That's why I need bench presses to build my chest and arms!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm...! Hmmmmmm!!
'Tis truly a vexing dilemma, aye!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, I cannot possibly choose between the two!
Therefore, how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Both yielding the machine to me—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: This machine would much rather be used by me than wasted by fools having petty squabbles!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Both of them talk about 'wanting to win,'
but who knows how serious they actually are, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Are you seriously saying that?!
—Do you have any idea how much this means to me?!”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwwaaah!? This is bad!!
Retreat, retreaaaat!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, that gave me quite a shock!
I never expected such fury to be directed my way.
choice_data_list: That's what happens when you put it like that...
That's what happens when you put it like that...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, there's no use crying over spilled milk.
Let us go train somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after that incident—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer. Wouldst thou pour me some tea?
I received some manjū as a token of gratitude♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you remember?
Those two who were arguing at the gym.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: They were exceedingly grateful to me for that matter!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Those two were roommates, you see. Voices of them bickering were heard constantly. It seemed quite troubling for those living in nearby rooms.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So I volunteered to solve the problem
for those troubled by the noise.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "If I do them a favor here, I might just be able to call in a favor for a scheme of mine later, heheh♪"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bitter enemies in the same boat—even those with differing views
can unite when faced with a common enemy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Actually, it seems those two decided to take turns using the machine after we left.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I'll let a clown like that
look down on me!" ...or so she said.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Everyone was happy that there were no fights now, I tell ye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that strategy only works if you actually stumble upon people arguing.
Last time was just a fluke because there happened to be only one machine open..."
choice_data_list: Wait, isn't that sign that says "Out of Order"...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I went ahead and put them up myself.
After checking their schedules and the equipment they usually use, of course.
choice_data_list: So it was all set up from that point on...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah!
Advance preparation is the key to any good scheme!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, everything went swimmingly!
As expected of me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I helped someone, received buns in return! And to top it off, I gathered intel on the counterstrategy my rival is cooking up!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Now this is truly killing three birds with one stone!
Nya-hahaha!!"
choice_data_list: I want to learn from how shrewd you are
I could learn a thing or two from how shrewd you are
It may have been a scheme, but you still helped someone—good on you!
It may have been a scheme, but you still helped someone—well done!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Now this is truly killing three birds with one stone!
Nya-hahaha!!"
choice_data_list: I want to learn from how shrewd you are
I could learn a thing or two from how shrewd you are
It may have been a scheme, but you still helped someone—good on you!
It may have been a scheme, but you still helped someone—well done!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us learn from the past!
We should study the Sengoku warlords who survived with unyielding grit!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I shall show you the way of life you ought to emulate! Follow me at once!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, No Reason recommended
some great history books to me.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Right? Right?!
You can praise me even more, you know!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
One can never have too many words of praise!
Here♪ Here, hereee♪
